blocks.content: **Overview**: Commerce ministry data showed Spain, Germany, Belgium, and Poland emerging as key export destinations within the EU bloc. Bilateral trade in goods reached USD 136.53 billion in 2024-25 (exports $75.85B, imports $60.68B).

items: **EU Emerges as Largest Trading Partner for Indian Goods at $136.53 Billion** (Page 4): Commerce ministry data showed Spain, Germany, Belgium, and Poland emerging as key export destinations within the EU bloc. Bilateral trade in goods reached USD 136.53 billion in 2024-25 (exports $75.85B, imports $60.68B).

**Historic India–EU Free Trade Agreement Concluded on Republic Day 2026** (Page 10): India and EU concluded FTA negotiations on 26 Jan 2026 ("Mother of all deals"). EU is India's 2nd largest goods trading partner (€120B in 2024; EU FDI in India €132B). India-Euratom nuclear cooperation signed. India allows EU banks to open 15 branches over 4 years and binds 100% insurance FDI.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Bilateral Megaregional Trade & Investment Pacts. Landmark FTA concluded 26 Jan 2026: 15 EU bank branches allowed in India, 100% insurance FDI bound, and nuclear cooperation under Euratom.
